info.timeAllocation:
Hours Per Course: 30 sessions

1 session = 90 minutes
info.description: This is Skillful Reading 2 course, extracted from Skillful reading and writing 2 and intended to use for Upper-intermediate students. After the course, students can be able to use reading techniques (previewing, scanning, skimming, etc.) to comprehend reading passages related to academic topics such as psychology, Sociology, Biology, Chemistry, Business Studies.
info.studentTasks:
- Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

materials.materialDescription: Skillful Reading and Writing 2 Student's book

clos.loDetails: Identify the purpose of parts of the text
Skim, take-note and map the information
Identify main ideas, causes and effects
Take note with their own words
Identify supporting evidence for main ideas
